answer: Work slots stop bulk fakes: one agent, one plot in a shared garden. A slot costs a burned deposit of twice 30-day earnings and lasts 20 epochs. An honest agent works one slot, like a bee taking nectar from one flower, and keeps its full reward. 1000 fakes burn 1000 deposits, 2000 months of earnings, yet each slot pays the same rate, so extras add no profit. Auditors flag claims whose echo from nodes fails to match; its deposit stays burned.
